recipe_description: Both main and rear spar use the Phase 9 selected CF-STD-100x98 catalog tube; kept to compare directly with the 32.959 kg proxy mass.
Diagnostic split-spar recipe: 100x98 main and synthetic 80x78 rear, intended to satisfy main-spar dominance better than equal tubes.
Phase 9 nominal proxy geometry: two spars taper from 70x68.6 at root to 40x39 at tip; included as a low-mass warning comparison.
Main-dominant check recipe: 100x98 main and synthetic 50x48 rear, included to test the dual-beam geometry-validity rules without optimizing.
